notes: Full day. An Arknights maintenance day (06:00-12:00, client 2.7.71 -> 2.7.81) with three boots: 08:44 (deploy restart 10:19), the 21:41 relay power-off, and 22:31 switched on by hand by the owner (game-write.txt 10-09 23:36 大阪 「机器 22:33 手动开机」). R24 (prewarm inside the maintenance window): since da65e68d the relay no longer installs or prewarms the Arknights client; the maintenance bulletin is fed from outside.jsonl (the site was not recorded), so the window logic (MAA out of 早班, re-run after 12:00) runs. R21 here is the push half only (192dfefa removed 「🌙 今晚不关机」); the 22:36 「本次开机还没有跑完任何队列」 was true on a fresh boot, so the mark-persistence half is not exercised. MAA's asst.log is recorded only from 10-10 14:46 (slice note), so MAA rounds are judged from AUTO-MAS history alone. The 12:18 skip mark was set by the relay-one session through modes.set_skip_shutdown, which leaves no relay.log line (status-中继一.md 10-09 13:13 大阪); it is an outside.jsonl input at 12:13, as is the bulletin. AUTO-MAS-Setup.exe of AUTO-MAS's 08:47 self-update is sliced from app.log's 「启动更新程序」.

items.why: Real that day: MaaEnd v2.32 reset the six 自动囤货 buy lists to defaults on load (maaend/debug/2026-10-09-3.log:182-187, checkbox -> switch). Current code rewrites the master into the new shape at every relay start (76df1839), so on the machine MaaEnd would have loaded the user's lists; the sim replays the recorded MaaEnd log against the 10-13 master, so it cannot tell which. Not decided here.

Arknights maintenance 06:00-12:00 (official bulletin): MAA is dropped from today's 早班 and re-run once the servers are back, so its absence from the 09:00 round is no missed run and no overrun (no 「MAA 没有运行」, no 「一直没出结果」).
MAA's own asst.log for 10-09 is not in the recorded data (asst.bak.log starts 10-10 14:46), so the sim's check reports 「MAA 自己的日志里没有这一轮的记录」; on the machine the log was there and the round passed.
As 1009-20 for the evening round: MAA's asst.log for 10-09 was not recorded.
